resumenes.verde: Clear sky while the moon is high. Worth going out.
resumenes.ambar: There will be clouds, but a gap may open. If you go, be patient and check the clouds every so often.
resumenes.rojo: Heavily overcast: the moon will barely be visible. Better another night.

motivos.lunaNueva: New moon: it is almost invisible. A good night for stars, not for the moon.
motivos.sinLunaAlta: Tonight the moon won't be high while it is dark.
motivos.yaPaso: There are no hours left tonight with the moon high.
motivos.lluviaFuerte: Heavy rain is expected while the moon is high.

frasesNubes.texto: Clear or almost clear sky: the moon will look clean.
Clouds now and then: you'll have to wait for a gap between them.
Overcast sky: the moon will barely show.

avisoNiebla: Low visibility (fog): the moon will look blurry.

brujula.altura: Altitude: {altura}° above the horizon, about {punos} fists at arm's length.
brujula.alturaUnPuno: Altitude: {altura}° above the horizon, about one fist at arm's length.

momentos.mejor: At {hora}, the best time of the night.

nueva.consejo: Almost invisible. A good night for stars, not for photographing the moon.

creciente.consejo: Soft light with a well-defined edge. Good for a thin moon over the landscape.

cuarto-creciente.consejo: The light comes from the side and brings out the relief of the craters. It is the phase with the most detail.

gibosa-creciente.consejo: Soft shadows and lots of brightness. With a telephoto lens you can see relief along the edge.

llena.consejo: Very bright, with flat light and no relief. It looks best within a landscape or among clouds.

gibosa-menguante.consejo: Soft shadows and lots of brightness. With a telephoto lens you can see relief along the edge.

cuarto-menguante.consejo: The light comes from the side and brings out the relief of the craters. It is the phase with the most detail.

menguante.consejo: Soft light with a well-defined edge. Good for a thin moon over the landscape.
